Director seat, summon #51 continuation (ledger objectstack#12708). Filed by this seat on the maintainer's 「同意」 to the check-retirement sweep (record 6433263738) and presented in batch #407 as item 1 of 1. The card carries the six items and the facets block; seat increment at filing:
- Run history re-read 2026-10-27T04:02Z on `main`: Spec Coverage 29 green / 1 red in 30 days, Engine Split Metric 5 / 0, Showcase Smoke 22 / 8 with the last six green; none of the three files an issue or is read by a script or a card (600 newest issues grepped).
- The seat recommends **B**: retire Spec Coverage and Engine Split Metric; move Showcase Smoke's nav-surface render assertion under Nightly Tiers (`*.live.test.*`), whose report job files a card per red file, so the one assertion with product value keeps a reader. Not A (loses the only nightly check that renders every showcase surface) and not C. Workload: devx · 1 Tier H PR (`.github/workflows/**`, lands by the maintainer's approval) · S.
Prior rulings read: coverage nightly · engine split · showcase smoke → ADR-0076 D7; maintainer 2026-09-07 「测试会不会太多」; thread: none.

Ruling: batch #407 item 1 · letter B · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-27T04:31Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). The maintainer answered batch #407 with 「同意」 — the seat letter. Brief 6433433659. Letter **B**: retire `.github/workflows/coverage-nightly.yml` (Spec Coverage) and `.github/workflows/engine-split-metric.yml` (Engine Split Metric, ADR-0076 D7 report-only) — the workflow files, their `check:*` wiring and any reader of their artifacts; `.github/workflows/showcase-smoke.yml` is retired as a workflow and its nav-surface render assertion moves under Nightly Tiers as a `*.live.test.*` so that a red files a card through that job's report step. Not A (the showcase assertion would run nowhere) and not C.

Workload (card column): devx · one Tier H PR (`.github/workflows/**`, lands by the maintainer's approval) · S; the test move is measured on the PR (Playwright against the live stack, the shape Nightly Tiers already runs). ADR-0076 D7's metric script may stay in `scripts/` unwired, or go with the workflow — the lane says which in the PR body; if it goes, the ADR gets a one-line note in a separate governed PR.

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:devx`, p2, `area:devpath`). `Ruling-ref:` names this comment. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

ADR-0076 D7's metric script either stays unwired in `scripts/` or goes, the PR body says which; an ADR note, if owed, is a separate governed PR (⛔ no `docs/adr/**` here). ⛔ No `ci.yml`, no `ui/.github/**`; a `ui/` test path only if the moved assertion must live beside the showcase app, and then named in the report. ⛔ Tier H (`.github/workflows/**`): draft until a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval; the dev neither readies nor arms auto-merge · Amended on the thread's hand-back (PR #26529): the moved assertion lives at `examples/app-showcase/test/showcase-smoke.live.test.ts` with `examples/app-showcase/vitest.config.ts`, `playwright.config.ts` and `types/node-shim.d.ts`; `turbo.json` (`showcase#test` inputs gain `scripts/nightly-tiers.mjs` and its `.d.mts`); the pins that counted the retired workflows: `scripts/check-stall-guard-budget.mjs` (battery 10 floor 13→12), `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs` (the engine-split live-tree case), `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` (source path); comment pointers in `half-state-patrol.yml` and `shard-timings-refresh.yml`; `scripts/check-engine-split-ratio.mjs` stays unwired (its `--self-test` stays in `lint.yml`)
Container & model: M, `mode:thread`, `model: default tier (TIER_DEFAULT, from dispatch-gates --tier: no path-derived mandate)`, `effort: medium`
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: n/a — decision card, ruling B

Premise: the three workflows exist on `main` with the 30-day histories the card measured and none writes an issue (the dev re-reads each file and greps every reader of their names and artifacts first)
Serial constraints cleared: no in-flight PR of this seat touches these three workflow files or `test-nightly-tiers.yml`
